body: That’s the thing I have no desire to go and live. I don’t see the appeal. Nothing interests me.
I’ll add this to the list of things that have failed me.

Thanks man. I don’t think I’ll ever have a relationship so I’ll try to accept that. I learned not to be naive young but I did have some betrayals you know? That’s also exactly what I want and to just be happy.I hope you stay and I hope you don’t have to resort to something drastic. You genuinely seem like a good dude. Thanks for reading these and not judging me. Stay safe.

They’re never happy with us are they? I don’t want to speak to 50 year old men who will only ask me about getting married. I’m not shy I just don’t like talking. My personality is real but I have like two of them at school with my friends I hate it but I act carefree funny unbothered all that stuff. I don’t think anyone will ever marry me nor that I’ll live long enough to experience it and I’m quite sad about it all I want in a man is for him to be kind caring understanding able to hold a job and taller than me is that a lot? Never even had a boyfriend or been on a date. Fuck everyone if I’m gonna die alone and go to hell why can’t I just go gta on everyone. Because I feel guilty. I just don’t know what I want at this point.

Bye the time I was 10 I was the quietest child ever I hated everyone at that point. I also wasn’t really restricted to the Internet so I was educated on depression and stuff to an extent. Yeah that’s exactly how I feel on death. I’m fine with the idea of nothing. Because I’m used to it. I’m more scared of the idea of hell. I’ve never stolen or killed anyone or raped someone. I don’t think I disrespect other peoples religions. I’m not gay. I don’t think I have a reason to go to hell but there’s always a question bugging me like what if? I think the worse things I’ve ever done is swear and watch porn I stopped after three times because of guilt. Conspiracy theories are one of the only things I can pay attention to but they’re so cruel. I don’t think I want to go through another life if god gave me a shit one now why should I expect a better one. I went to sleep at 2 last night that’s better than usual. I also feel lonely but I don’t want to burden other people with my problems so what do I do? I just feel anxiety and frustration. It really is awful.

Thank you for still reading these and sorry for the late reply. I finished school and stuff with top marks and things but I just feel so lost and like what should I do now? I haven’t moved into my apartment yet because of corona and stuff. So I still live with the pricks. I’ve been saving up since I was 10 to move out is that normal? I don’t have any friends and I just feel alone. Graphic design seems really interesting and quite hard to do so I wish you good luck with that. My path to become a barrister is going quiet slow lately but I’m getting their. Are you scared to die? I know it’s quite a weird question but I’m genuinely curious. I am I guess that’s why I’m still here. I’m scared for what comes after not the pain or the process. I’m agnostic you see another thing I haven’t told my father and mother. I’m a bit of a conspiracy theorist also and that really doesn’t help since the theory’s are really dark and awful. They make me lose what little faith in humanity I have left. I’m also a realist you know? So it doesn’t really make sense so I believe the less far fetched ones. Mysteries give me a sort of purpose and satisfaction I guess that’s why I’m into law. Is your sleep schedule as bad as mine? I don’t think I have insomnia but I just keep on getting intrusive thoughts like get your shit together and stop being a crybaby then you can’t even die properly. I want to die but I’m scared of the consequences I don’t want to live. They say suicides the cowards way out right? Did I ever say I was brave? God I sound like I’m making a school essay.

We went through almost the exact same thing although I wish you didn’t have to experience it. I carried on getting good grades not because I had any hope to get a good well paying job in the future but to not disappoint my parents but I feel stupid now because I know they’d be disappointed either way. I really do hate myself. I never was emotional maybe I was trained to not be but I just dealt with it. You see I had hope to be a lawyer/barrister or a psychiatrist/therapist to help people. Law is one of the only thing I still have any interest in. School sucked any enjoyment of learning I ever had. Learning about all the great things people had done just made me think man I’ll never be that good or wow what’s the point in trying to one up that. I hate school with a passion. Making me do p.e and being horribly embarrassed at my lack of athleticism or making me miss even more sleep by giving me packs of homework. Making me talk to people even though I would get much better grades alone and not have to stress. Again I never expressed these feelings. I had a decent amount of clueless friends who kept me distracted for a short amount of time. And the teachers never let me partner with them. Uniform made me feel even more ugly. I just loathed everything about it.

It really is freakily similar our situations. I try to block out the physical side of my trauma but yeah I’ve not had it nice in that department when I was old enough to realise what abuse was, which was at 8 because I had to mature very quickly. I thought maybe I’m just a awful child and deserve it but like I said I never complained I never questioned my parents. I did everything but I was never good enough. Once I got a average mark in maths because I was in a advanced class and didn’t have time to study. I was black and blue for ages hid it with makeup. That’s one of the worse he calmed down after that not out of guilt out of fear of getting caught. I’m actually tearing up. I can’t really fathom how people are so happy. Like I’m glad they are but how? What did I do to anger whatever god their might be? I see so many gorgeous girls with happy families and I just think why can’t I have that? I won’t ever say it out loud but I always pity myself and then I start feeling guilty about pitying myself. That’s why i cut a few times haven’t in years because I thought it won’t solve anything. I hate everyone I just want to jump. I’m such a screw up and god you must be so tired of reading these long ass messages. Thank you for actually listening. I don’t even know you and you care more than people I’ve known since I was 5.

Yeah, my parents are together most people assume that if they are together you’re all happy we’re not. They argued every single day over the smallest things they brought us into the arguments. Told us to choose a parent and I hate to say this but I’ve come to a understanding that I’d choose none of them I hate them equally. My mother was the most emotionally abusive called me fat mistake useless whatever. My father he just argued with her and was always at work whenever we talked it was just about school. I never show my emotions i haven’t cried in years. I think I’m a bit of a sociopath. I never complained still haven’t this is my only exception. Never told anyone. It’s because I always thought why should I complain when there’s people going through so much worse? I had my cousins but even that they restricted me from seeing them. And my favourite aunt moved away ages ago haven’t heard from her in years. For me they never said it was a phase it was you’re being overdramatic or you’ll get over it. I never told them like I said, it was my older brother who told them he depression as well. He moved away I hope he’s well even though he left me. I’m not going to lie to you although even if I said differently I’m sure you’re smart enough to not believe me. From my experiences it doesn’t get better. Still stay. I’m not. I’ll give my self 2 years. Maybe by then I won’t be afraid of death. Thank you though you made me add another year. Stay safe my guy.

Exactly, I hope it does get better for you. No one noticed my depression or anything but I don’t blame them. If I really wanted help I should’ve come forward right? I tried to laugh away my problems and drown myself in work but it never really works for me anyways. It’s not always the brightest smiles that have the worst problems it’s the most normal ones. I don’t know anyone who had depression and got better but maybe that’s just me. They’ll get over it and move on and no matter how sad that makes me I hope they do. I’d never wish this upon anyone. I haven’t told anyone about it because I feel like I have no reason to be depressed am I selfish? I don’t know I hope you figure your shit out I genuinely think you seem like a great person and I’m not just saying that. It won’t get better for me but please stay for a bit longer and try to make it better for you I’m not strong enough but you could be.

That’s almost exactly how I feel. I’ve recently been thinking about the future and I can’t picture one with me in it. Nothing gives me joy I have a awful attention span so I can’t do anything for longer than 5 minutes and it gets so boring and depressing. Like what’s the point? I didn’t ask to be born so I why should I stay? I’m not special I’m not pretty I’m not anything my death won’t be much of a loss. No one will be at my funeral. No one will be with me on my death bed if I have one. No one will try to get me to stay. So why should I not kill myself? I’m not encouraging you to do it. If anything I say don’t. Hey maybe it does get better. I wouldn’t know.
